identity.name: Cultist-3.2-1B
identity.summary: A merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only mergekit/SLERP merge of pretrained LMs and no training/evaluation documentation, so inner workings and development process are undocumented.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not state the provenance or license terms of the merged base models' training data, only names the merged model and source repos.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: No information is provided about collection, curation, or use of training data for the merged models, making training-data documentation absent.

possible_risks.description: Toxic output occurs when the model produces hateful, abusive, and profane (HAP) or obscene content. This also includes behaviors like bullying.
possible_risks.justification: The named source 'lewd-mental-occult' and 'Sigil-Of-Satan' suggest the merge may produce obscene or occult-themed content, and no safety evaluation is reported.

possible_risks.description: A jailbreaking attack attempts to break through the guardrails established in the model to perform restricted actions.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight merged model with no reported guardrails or safety evaluation can be used to bypass alignment protections.

specifications.model_size: 2.8 GiB of safetensors weights (2,996,982,344 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model is a merge of pretrained language models, created using mergekit with the SLERP merge method.
